geometry.derivation_method: CL-DATA-77 2026-11-20: 建功嶼 (Jiangong Islet) OSM Nominatim node 24.4273629,118.2999844.

observation_relations.derivation_method: CL-DATA-77 web verification 2026-11-20: azimuth = initial great-circle bearing (WGS84 geodesic, north=0 clockwise) from the verified camera point to the verified target point, computed with a spherical earth (R=6371km); OSM Nominatim nodes retrieved 2026-11-20. Result: az=284 deg (dist ~0.46 km) — west along the stone causeway to the islet; replaces the legacy V1 weather_details azimuth 270 (CL-DATA-13 backfill), which sits within the same wide tolerance band.
observation_relations.uncertainty_note: Wide tolerance: the causeway curves and the composition includes the islet AND its baroque gate; the legacy 270 and computed 284 agree within ~14 deg.

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 潮汐決定型（CL-COND-A7 慣例）：金門縣政府依潮汐公布每日建議登島時段（乾潮前後約 ±30 分，石板道僅乾潮露出）；漲潮淹沒即封閉，日落後禁止登島。V2 評估層尚無潮汐資料源——誠實 propagate unknown（fail-closed → NOT_EVALUABLE）；legacy 管線已接 tide_state（low_access_window）。拍攝指南：查金門觀光旅遊網建功嶼潮汐表與現場公告。
rationale_i18n.en: Tide-decided subject (CL-COND-A7 convention): the Kinmen County Government publishes a daily recommended landing window keyed to the tide (about +/- 30 minutes around low tide; the stone causeway shows only at ebb); the rising tide closes it and landing is prohibited after sunset. The V2 evaluation layer has no tide data source - honest propagate unknown (fail-closed -> NOT_EVALUABLE); the legacy pipeline already carries tide_state (low_access_window). Shooting guide: check the Kinmen travel site tide table and on-site notices.
rationale_i18n.ja: 潮位決定型（CL-COND-A7 慣例）：金門県政府は潮汐に応じて毎日の上島推奨時刻を公表（干潮前後約±30分、石板道は干潮時のみ現れる）；満潮で閉鎖、日の入り後の上島は禁止。V2評価層に潮汐データソースがない — 誠実に propagate unknown（fail-closed → NOT_EVALUABLE）；legacy パイプラインは tide_state を実装済み（low_access_window）。撮影ガイド：金門観光旅遊網の建功嶼潮汐表と現地告知を確認。

notes_i18n.zh-TW: 2026-11-20 CL-DATA-76（owner 裁決）：legacy_mountain_view 佔位取代為官方乾潮登島窗＋黃金時段錨點。來源：金門觀光旅遊網建功嶼潮汐頁 https://www.kinmen.travel/zh-tw/guide/jiangongyu-islet-tidal | 2026-11-20 CL-INT-212 整合：本契約為語義合併——CL-DATA-76 的真實條件組（潮汐/光窗/降水）＋ CL-DATA-77 的實測幾何與方位；資料值以最新裁決版（CL-DATA-77）為準。
notes_i18n.en: 2026-11-20 CL-DATA-76 (owner ruling): the legacy_mountain_view placeholder is replaced by the official low-tide landing window plus a golden-hour anchor. Source: Kinmen travel site Jiangong Islet tide page https://www.kinmen.travel/zh-tw/guide/jiangongyu-islet-tidal | 2026-11-20 CL-INT-212 integration: semantic merge - CL-DATA-76 real condition set (tide/light-window/precipitation) + CL-DATA-77 verified geometry and azimuth; data values follow the latest adjudicated version (CL-DATA-77).
notes_i18n.ja: 2026-11-20 CL-DATA-76（オーナー裁定）：legacy_mountain_view のプレースホルダを公式干潮上島窓＋ゴールデンアワーの錨に置換。出典：金門観光旅遊網 建功嶼潮汐ページ https://www.kinmen.travel/zh-tw/guide/jiangongyu-islet-tidal | 2026-11-20 CL-INT-212 統合：意味論マージ — CL-DATA-76 の実条件セット（潮汐/光窓/降水）＋ CL-DATA-77 の検証済み幾何・方位；データ値は最新裁定版（CL-DATA-77）に従う。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 黃金時段錨點：官方規定日落後禁止登島，拍攝窗必須在日落前的黃金光線內；夕陽金光灑在潮間帶與石板道是本題材的招牌畫面。
rationale_i18n.en: Golden-hour anchor: landing is prohibited after sunset by the official rule, so the shoot must sit inside the golden light before sunset; golden light over the tidal flats and the stone causeway is the subject's signature frame.
rationale_i18n.ja: ゴールデンアワーの錨：公式規則で日の入り後の上島は禁止——撮影は日の入り前の黄金光の中に限る。潮間帯と石板道に差す金色の光が本題材の代表作。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 拍攝時降雨 <0.3 mm/h：既審通用門檻；雨中石板道濕滑。
rationale_i18n.en: Precipitation < 0.3 mm/h at shoot time: reviewed generic threshold; the wet stone causeway is slippery.
rationale_i18n.ja: 撮影時の降水<0.3mm/h。既承認閾値。雨の石板道は滑りやすい。
